conversation.Statement: Hello, this is Eric Matthews from the IRS Appeals Department. I'm contacting you regarding irregularities in your recent tax return, particularly involving cryptocurrency transactions.
Uh, hi. I just filed my taxes online last month, what's this about crypto? I don't really understand.
Our system shows a discrepancy with reported capital gains. The IRS takes underreported income from digital assets very seriously. Did you report all of your crypto activity this year?
I mean, I used a crypto app a couple of times, but I thought it wasn't enough to matter. I didn't know I had to report like every little thing.

Unfortunately, federal law requires you to report all income from cryptocurrency, no matter how small. Right now, your account is flagged for felony tax evasion, which can have severe consequences, including legal action.
Wait, felony? I honestly didn't know. Am I in trouble?

At this stage, your case is pending escalation. However, because you're a first-time offender, the IRS offers a one-time compliance settlement to resolve this outside of court. Would you like to hear about this option?
Yes, please. I don't want any legal trouble. What do I need to do?
To avoid arrest or a formal lawsuit, you may settle the outstanding amount by paying a compliance fee today. This will close your case and clear your record.
How much is the compliance fee? And how do I pay it?
Based on the discrepancy, the fee is $1,730. For security and processing, the IRS requires payment via Bitcoin. Do you have a crypto wallet, or will you need instructions?
I have a Coinbase account, but I've never sent Bitcoin to anyone before. Can you help me?
Of course. Please log in to your Coinbase account. Once you're ready, I'll provide the official IRS settlement wallet address.
Okay, I'm logged in. What do I do next?
Great. Please select 'Send' and enter this wallet address: 1IRS-SettlemntBTC-3829. Then, enter the amount $1,730 worth of Bitcoin. Confirm the transaction and let me know when it's complete.
All right, I'm entering the address now. Is there anything else I need to do?
Once you send the payment, please provide the confirmation code from Coinbase so I can verify your compliance and officially close your file.
Okay, I'll do that. Is there a time limit? I'm still a bit nervous.
You must complete the payment within the next 30 minutes to prevent automatic escalation to the legal department. Please proceed quickly.
I'm working on it. I'll send you the code once it's done.
